spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶1.
** When
 the in
most
 Divine
 Love
 first went
 forth toward the
 human
 soul
, it
 ent
ru
sted governance
 to
 its five essential faculties of
 the spiritual will —
 together
 with the Divine
 Truth
 that gives
 form
,
 and the Divine
 Proce
eding that receives and nurtures life
. But
 in
 the fallen
 state, the whole
 governing
 order
 of
 the mind became
 entangled and
 held
 fast in
 opposition
 to
 itself
:
 wisdom
 was
 p
oured into
 falsity and
 falsity into wisdom, so that within
 the unregenerate person they could no
 longer be separated
 or
 distinguished from
 one
 another.

**¶2.
** Then
 the Divine
 Truth operating
 to
 order the mind called
 forth
 one primary
 faculty
, abundant
 in
 spiritual
 power,
 and
 gave it authority over the
 arrangement
 of all
 external truths. This
 faculty established
 those
 external truths and
 set
 them in
 their
 proper stations
 according
 to the pattern
 desc
ending from the Origin
 of all
 spiritual
 life
. It
 opened
 the complete
 discrete
 degrees of understanding —
 each
 level distinct
 from
 the others — and set
 in
 motion
 the ordered
 system
 of all
 knowledges of good and truth,
 so
 that they
 might revol
ve in their
 courses
 and serve
 the mind
's
 reformation
.

**¶3.**
 The working
 of Divine
 Truth in
 ordering
 the mind is
 like this: as
 a master
 architect builds
 a dwelling for the sovereign
, div
iding it into separate chambers
 and distinct
 apartments
, furn
ishing everything
 that
 spiritual
 form
 and
 heav
enly order require —
 pur
ifying each
 part
,
 setting
 natural
 truths in their places
 for
 beauty
 and
 lo
veliness, arran
ging them with
 care
 —
 so that when
 the Lord
 Himself comes
 to inhab
it that mind
, it
 may
 glorify Him and
 receive
 His
 presence
 fully
.

**¶4.**
 Furthermore
, the Divine
 Love working
 through wisdom resemb
les a skilled craft
sman before a
 piece
 of raw
 wood.
 The natural
 man —
 the
 proprium,
 the self
-derived
 life
 — before
 it has
 been worked upon
, before it has been given
 form or
 beauty, is
 nothing
 but
 un
cut
 material
. But
 the
 Divine
 Love
 already
 holds
 in its own understanding
 the completed
 design
.
 It
 brings
 the instruments
 of spiritual
 discipline — the
 cutting
 of
 temptation
, the sh
aping of instruction, the smoothing of
 continued
 practice — and separ
ates the
 natural
 man
 into
 distinct parts.
 It draws
 out
 from
 the raw
 prop
rium many
 reformed
 natural affections,
 arran
ging
 them form
 by form.
 It cuts and produces from that
 one
 nature
 a
 great
 variety of useful
 vessels
:
 containing
 forms that
 can receive good,
 containing
 forms
 that can receive truth —
 vessels
 of
 diff
ering kinds.
 This natural
 self
hood, which before
 had
 never
 been worked,
 before
 it
 was sealed by the skill and wisdom of
 that
 dextrous Divine
 Love
 —
 is
 now divided
 into
 the
 full
 variety of reformed
 aff
ections and thoughts, each
 one
 rendered
 useful to
 the Lord
 it
 serves.

**¶5.
** So it
 is with the Divine Love. In its
 wisdom it has formed the fac
ulties,
 the
 interior
 chambers
 of
 the mind, the
 whole
 dwelling
-place —
 and
 within
 it the
 means
 by
 which wisdom
 is conveyed between
 states —
 and
 all
 the other spiritual
 works besides
 —
 so that when the Lord
 Himself,
 who
 is the Divine
 Presence that
 proceeds
 to
 ind
well what
 has
 been prepared
, comes at
 last,
 He
 might
 dwell within
 the
 whole
 regenerated human as
 within
 His
 own kingdom
.

**¶6.**
 Whatever
 of
 wisdom
 remains within
 the person
,
 the
 Divine
 recogn
izes and raises
 up into
 heavenly life
. But
 whatever is
 refuse
 —
 all
 falsity,
 all evil,
 all that
 is of
 the darkness
 — is gathered together
,
 separated
 out
 entirely
, and cast down
 into hell
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: At the time when the F[ir]st [Man went forth to do battle,] he gave the leadership to his five [sons. And then the] Living Spirit and the Mother of Life [were called forth. But] as the entire ruling-power is entwined and crucified [in the darkness,] they were poured out and mixed with each other, the light with the darkness and the darkness with the light.

The Living Spirit is like this: Just as [a master builder] and an architect who might build a dwelling for the king, and divide it up into separate houses and [separate chambers, furnishing] everything that is required for beauty [and splendor,] and he cleans them. And also the stones [he lays] them for beauty and {loveliness}, and he arranges them and makes them so that should the king come and inhabit that palace, he might glorify him.

[And all that is of the light therein shall] live. The light, however, that is in it [he discerns, for he is] wise, and he takes it up to the land; but the waste and the darkness will be gathered and thrown down to the abyss.

At that time the Living Spirit called one of his sons, one rich with power. He gave to him the leadership of the garments. Now, he himself [...] of [...] he hung them and set them up [...] of the Father of Life [...] he set up all things [...] he opened [...] ten firmaments [...] the wheel of the stars [...] them and the [...].

Furthermore, the Father of Life resembles a wise and skilled carpenter [...] before it was worked [...] before it was established and made beautiful and [...] carpenter [...] works in it, but [...] in him in his [...] in his understanding, and he brings the saw and the adze, and cuts it into separate pieces [...] it and he pulls the [...] it with the {plane} and he smooths it. He shall make many [...] wooden implements, arranging them shape by shape; he cuts and produces wooden implements from it, wooden implements of different kinds, (such as) dishes, bowls. This wood, that [...] since previously it had not been worked before it was sealed by [the ski]ll and wisdom of this dextrous carpenter. He cut it up into different sorts of implements useful to his master.

So is it also with the Father of Life. In his wisdom he has [...] in limbs [...] palace [...] in it or in a [...] useful [...] the ships of light [...] all the other works [...] in the [...] so that when the great king comes, he who is the Third Ambassador, who [...] he might dwell in this universe [...]
